goal.vi: Bắt chuyện, tìm điểm chung, rủ đi chơi và giữ liên lạc.
goal.en: Start a chat, find things in common, make a plan and keep in touch.

dialogue.aRole: a guest at a friend's birthday party
lines: Hi, I'm Leo. So how do you know Emma?
We went to school together. What do you do for fun?
I'm really into hiking these days.
No way, me too! Are you free this Saturday? A few of us are going to the lake.
I'd love to! I'll text you. What's your number?
Here. It was great hanging out with you.
You too. Let's keep in touch!

phrases.say: So how do you know Emma?

mean.vi: Hỏi người kia quen chủ nhà thế nào
mean.en: Ask how someone knows the host

why.vi: Câu hỏi mở đầu rất dễ ở một bữa tiệc.
why.en: An easy first question at a party.

phrases.say: I'm really into hiking these days.

mean.vi: Nói về sở thích của bạn
mean.en: Talk about what you like doing

why.vi: "Into" là cách nói tự nhiên, thân mật cho "rất thích".
why.en: "Into" is a natural, casual way to say you like something.

mean.vi: Hào hứng khi thấy điểm chung
mean.en: Show you are happy to share something

why.vi: Nói "me too"; "me also" nghe không tự nhiên.

phrases.say: Are you free this Saturday? A few of us are going hiking.

mean.vi: Rủ người mới quen đi chơi
mean.en: Invite a new friend to do something

why.vi: Đưa ra kế hoạch cụ thể để người kia dễ nhận lời.
why.en: Give a real plan, so it's easy to say yes.

phrases.say: It was great hanging out with you.
phrases.not: It was nice to play with you.

mean.vi: Nói bạn đã vui khi gặp người kia
mean.en: Say you enjoyed your time together

why.vi: Người lớn "hang out"; "play" dùng cho trẻ em hoặc trò chơi.
why.en: Adults "hang out"; "play" is for kids or games.

mean.en: Say you want to stay in contact

why.vi: Cụm cố định là "keep in touch".
why.en: The fixed phrase is "keep in touch".

phrases.not: I will send you message the details.

mean.vi: Nói bạn sẽ nhắn tin cho người kia
mean.en: Say you will send a text

why.vi: Ở Mỹ, "text" thường được dùng như động từ.
why.en: In American English, "text" is a common verb.

ai.name: Leo
ai.role: a guest at a friend's birthday party
ai.persona: relaxed, friendly and likes the outdoors
ai.goal: get to know the learner and maybe make a plan

roleplay.you: Chat with a new person at a party: say how you know the host, talk about something you're into, make a plan and keep in touch.

turns.a: Hi, I'm Leo. So how do you know Emma?
turns.h: Hi Leo! We work together. How do you know her?

turns.a: What do you like to do on weekends?
turns.h: I'm really into hiking these days.

turns.a: I love hiking too! A few of us are going to the lake on Saturday.
turns.h: No way, me too! Are you sure I can join?
br: Of course! The more the better.

turns.h: Thanks! I'll text you. It was great hanging out with you.

roleplay.end: See you on Saturday! Don't forget good shoes.
